name: Andaz Xiamen
insider_take: This sleek Andaz property captures Xiamen's dynamic spirit as a gateway between mainland China and Taiwan, where cutting-edge design meets centuries-old maritime heritage.
whats_special: The hotel showcases locally-inspired art and design elements that reflect Xiamen's unique position as a historic trading port. Located in the bustling Siming District, you're perfectly positioned to explore the UNESCO World Heritage site of Gulangyu Island, accessible by a quick ferry ride. The city's famous seafood culture and distinctive Minnan architecture create an authentic Southern Fujian experience.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room to catch stunning sunsets over Xiamen Bay, and time your visit during the cooler months (October-December) when the weather is perfect for island hopping and outdoor exploration.
dont_miss: Take the 5-minute ferry to car-free Gulangyu Island to explore colonial mansions and the famous Piano Museum. Back on the mainland, stroll down Zhongshan Road for authentic Hokkien street food, and visit Nanputuo Temple, one of China's most important Buddhist sites, just minutes from your hotel.
pros: Modern luxury design with contemporary local touches
Prime location in Xiamen's central business district
Exceptional dining experiences with innovative cuisine
Hyatt Prive benefits including room upgrades and credits
cons: Urban setting may lack traditional coastal resort atmosphere
